build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function as a PHYRE task script
create_dynamic_bars_with_C_add: use C.add to create dynamic bar bodies with scale, angle, bottom, and left parameters
position_body_with_set: use body.set to position a PHYRE body by setting its left and bottom coordinates
create_dynamic_ball_with_C_add: use C.add to create a dynamic ball body with a specified scale value
update_task_with_spatial_relationship: use C.update_task to define a task goal with body1, body2, and a SpatialRelationship
